report_name: ShinyHunters Data Leaks Fuel $2,000 Sextortion Email Scam

threat_actors.name: Sextortion Campaign Actors
threat_actors.description: Opportunistic cybercriminals impersonating the ShinyHunters group to conduct a widespread sextortion email campaign. They leverage publicly available data from past breaches to add credibility to their threats, demanding $2,000 in Bitcoin.

threat_actors.name: ShinyHunters
threat_actors.description: A notorious extortion group whose name and previously leaked data are being used by opportunistic scammers in a widespread sextortion campaign. The actual ShinyHunters group is not believed to be running this specific campaign.

attack_patterns.name: Phishing
attack_patterns.description: The sextortion campaign is delivered via personalized emails designed to cause fear and panic, pressuring the victim to comply with the financial demand.

attack_patterns.name: Email Addresses
attack_patterns.description: The attackers acquired target email lists from publicly available data breach dumps, many of which originated from past activities of the ShinyHunters group.

attack_patterns.name: Financial Theft
attack_patterns.description: The goal of the campaign is financial extortion, demanding a payment of $2,000 in Bitcoin to prevent the release of fabricated compromising webcam footage.

attack_patterns.name: Impersonation
attack_patterns.description: The scam emails use the display name 'ShinyHunters' or 'You've Been HACKED' to capitalize on the group's notoriety and increase the believability of the threat.

campaigns.name: ShinyHunters Impersonation Sextortion Campaign
campaigns.description: A widespread sextortion email campaign where scammers impersonate the ShinyHunters group, using data from their past leaks to demand $2,000 in Bitcoin from victims under the false pretense of having compromising webcam footage.

identities.name: ShinyHunters
identities.description: Notorious extortion group being impersonated by scammers in a sextortion campaign.

identities.name: Amtrak
identities.description: One of the companies whose previously leaked customer data is being used to target individuals in the sextortion campaign.

identities.name: Hallmark
identities.description: One of the companies whose previously leaked customer data is being used to target individuals in the sextortion campaign.

identities.name: Panera Bread
identities.description: One of the companies whose previously leaked customer data is being used to target individuals in the sextortion campaign.

indicators.name: Sextortion Email Subject Line Pattern
indicators.pattern:
title: Sextortion Campaign Email Subject
id: 2b9a1c3d-f4e5-4b8a-9c1d-0e8f7a6b5c4d
status: experimental
description: Detects a subject line commonly used in a sextortion campaign impersonating ShinyHunters.
references:
  - https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/shinyhunters-data-leaks-fuel-2-000-sextortion-email-scam/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-07-25
tags:
  - attack.t1566
level: medium
logsource:
  category: email
detection:
  selection:
    Subject|contains: 'Information about your online security'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects emails with the subject line 'Information about your online security', which is used in the sextortion campaign.

indicators.name: Sextortion Email Sender Display Name

id: 8d7c6b5a-4f3e-4d2c-8b1a-9e0f8a7b6c5d
